from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
im=np.array(Image.open('inputs/01-source_artwork.png'))
rgb=im[:,:,:3].astype(float); a=im[:,:,3]
protos=np.array([[35,42,91],[255,255,255],[252,239,144]],float)
d=((rgb[:,:,None,:]-protos[None,None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)
lab=d.argmin(-1)
for k,name in [(0,'navy'),(1,'white'),(2,'yellow')]:
 m=(lab==k)&(a==255)
 m=ndimage.binary_erosion(m,iterations=3)
 vals=rgb[m]
 print(name,'n',len(vals),'mean',vals.mean(0),'median',np.median(vals,0),'std',vals.std(0))
 ys,xs=np.where(m)
 for axis,v in [('y',ys),('x',xs)]:
  q=np.quantile(v,[0,.25,.5,.75,1])
  out=[]
  for lo,hi in zip(q[:-1],q[1:]):
   sel=(v>=lo)&(v<=hi)
   out.append(np.mean(vals[sel],0).round(2).tolist())
  print(' ',axis,q.round(1).tolist(),out)
PY"

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
import vectorize_luna as v
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
src,arr,rgb,a=v.load_source(); sm=v.build_masks(rgb,a)
vec=np.array(Image.open(v.PREVIEW_PATH).convert('RGBA'))
labels=v.color_labels(vec[:,:,:3].astype('float32')); va=vec[:,:,3]
raw_y=(labels==2)&(va>=128); clean_y=v.keep_components(raw_y,500,8)
raw_n=(labels==0)&(va>=128); clean_n=v.keep_components(raw_n,100,None)
for name,s,t in [('yellow',sm['yellow_visible'],clean_y),('navy',sm['navy_visible'],clean_n)]:
 print(name,'iou',v.iou(s,t),'pixels',s.sum(),t.sum(),'edge',v.edge_distances(s,t))
# SVG/PDF alpha/color mask parity
pdf=np.array(Image.open(v.PDF_RENDER).convert('RGBA'))
svg=np.array(Image.open(v.SVG_RENDER).convert('RGBA'))
for th in [1,32,64,128,192,254]: print('alpha iou',th,v.iou(svg[:,:,3]>=th,pdf[:,:,3]>=th))
print('mean',np.abs(svg.astype('i16')-pdf.astype('i16')).mean(),'p95',np.percentile(np.abs(svg.astype('i16')-pdf.astype('i16')),95),'p99',np.percentile(np.abs(svg.astype('i16')-pdf.astype('i16')),99),'max',np.abs(svg.astype('i16')-pdf.astype('i16')).max())
